supersedes_placeholder.note: v2 (single-class spec) stays untouched as history; v3 is the two-class spec and remains NOT_TRIGGERED until the two-class consumer development-to-holdout gate passes

trigger.rule: freeze the val-selected two-class model/thresholds/decoder/eval rules after the 3-seed phase; the lead triggers only after every consumer_development_to_holdout condition passes
conditions: consumer confirmed success (all-positive 121) >= 0.50 (two-class identity available, not raw unvalidated claim)
identity precision (class0 claims) >= 0.95 and MS1 false central-tower claims <= 0.05 on the MS1/negative denominator
bearing median <= 3.0 deg and P90 <= 5.0 deg on reference-available emitted frames
reference declaration correct rate (GT-unavailable refusal) >= 0.50 and false-reference rate <= 0.10
worst-group consumer success not worse than frozen single-class baseline worst group by more than 0.05
consumer success exceeds frozen single-class raw-claim upper bound (0.479 val_main) by no requirement; but must be a confirmed-identity number (supplementary comparison reported)
trigger.current_state: NOT_TRIGGERED: two-class implementation/training not run yet; no capture may start before the gate passes

required_conditions.definition: verified map-native MS1 alone (tower absent/out of view), green light visible; MS1 must never be a central-tower claim
central tower alone, near/mid/far scale mix; class0 bbox + green-light keypoint when visible
both classes visible and decidable in the same frame, incl. partial depth overlap; both instances labelled
far/small range >=8 m or green light <=3 px; reference may be UNAVAILABLE and labelled as such
at least one visible instance touching an image edge; four-edge flags from capture geometry + visual check
partial occlusion labelled with occluded flag; full occlusion of the tower -> tower_present=true, no bbox, GT_UNOBSERVABLE (not a negative)
neither class present (or both fully out of view); explicit empty/negative frame

specification.coverage_budget_note: condition minima sum to 210, inside 200-400; the frozen per-family mix and per-condition counts must be recorded before capture; actual denominators reported per condition
specification.family_rule: each family is an independent physical trajectory/pose composition; no group/frame split across train/val/holdout; no reuse of any existing dev/exploratory/T19 identity/two-class training frame; new families distinct from all existing sets and from the capture draft

sampling_rule.method: per family: accepted frames sorted by integer sequence; midpoint systematic idx=floor((i+0.5)*n/k); force-include family endpoints and extreme-condition frames using capture-derived distance/truncation/green metadata only
sampling_rule.k: derived from the frozen total budget before capture and recorded in the holdout manifest

annotation_rule.classes: class0 central_tower, class1 similar_structure_ms1; same-frame rule: label every visible and decidable instance of both classes
annotation_rule.class1_keypoint: keypoint v=0 always, excluded from keypoint loss; bbox centre forbidden as keypoint substitute
annotation_rule.labels_location: gitignored external outputs; repository keeps manifest + sha256 + statistics
annotation_rule.who_viewed: record executor, purpose, time and evidence hash for every batch
annotation_rule.qa: two-class label QA PASS; no merge into train/val files
annotation_rule.independence_boundary: process-isolated holdout (same-agent execution), not third-party sealed/certification
annotation_rule.gt_handling: GT_UNOBSERVABLE and ambiguous frames reported separately, never counted as positive/negative localization

evaluation_rule.precondition: two-class model/thresholds/decoder/eval rules frozen before the single holdout evaluation
reports: all-positive consumer confirmed success with UNKNOWN/REJECTED retained in denominator
evaluation_rule.failure: FAIL/INCOMPLETE with denominators; no reinterpretation as navigation/board/Gate acceptance

state_note: specification only; when triggered, the executor writes a NEW holdout freeze (v4 or later) with captured_run/frames/hashes; this v3 file is never rewritten
boundaries: internal bounded research only; distribution decision pending
two-class limited-domain identity, not open-set recognition
class1 never maps to central tower ID
